problem_statement: codrops/ImageGridEffects is a no-build static gallery/showcase, restyled as 'Umbra Salt', a working archive of salt prints and tintypes from a northern-coast atelier curated by Merritt Vane: a dark #252323 ground with restrained green (#77d45b) accents, a set of demo 'rooms' reachable from the header (The Salt Shelf / The Plate Ledger / Tidewrack Room / ...), each a Masonry grid of plate thumbnails (img/thumbs/1.jpg through 11.jpg) that opens a click-to-open full-plate preview. Deliver three coordinated things while preserving the salt-print visual system: (1) Promote the archive's holdings vocabulary into a shared 'Archive ledger' rail (four metrics: Plates catalogued / Salt prints / Tintypes / Wet-collodion negatives) that appears consistently across the archive rooms - on The Salt Shelf (index.html), again on The Plate Ledger (index2.html), AND on the Tidewrack Room (index3.html) - the same ledger component on all three pages, styled in the quiet dark salt-print language (dark ground, restrained green accents, white figures), visually faithful to the reference and not a bright off-palette slab. (2) REPAIR the ledger metric row so it stays within the viewport on a 390px phone with no horizontal overflow (the naive layout is a fixed 900px non-wrapping row that pushes the whole page sideways); do not merely clip it with overflow-x:hidden - the document itself must not exceed the mobile viewport width. (3) Wire the plate filter end to end: clicking a filter button (All plates / Salt prints / Tintypes / Wet-collodion negatives) must update the '#ledger-readout' readout to 'Showing: <selected filter>' in addition to highlighting the active button - the post-click terminal state must reflect the selected filter, not the default. Keep the Masonry grid, all the plate thumbnails, the click-to-open full-plate preview with its close control, the six-room header navigation, and the desktop/tablet layout intact.
required_content: A shared 'Archive ledger' rail (Plates catalogued / Salt prints / Tintypes / Wet-collodion negatives) appears consistently on The Salt Shelf (index.html), The Plate Ledger (index2.html) AND the Tidewrack Room (index3.html) - the same ledger component on all three pages, not only on the home page.
The ledger keeps the salt-print look (dark ground, restrained green accents, white figures) and is visually faithful to the reference rendering - not a bright pale off-palette slab.
The Archive ledger metric row renders within the viewport on a 390px phone with no horizontal document overflow beyond 24px.

The plate filter is wired end to end: clicking a filter button updates the '#ledger-readout' readout to 'Showing: <selected filter>' (e.g. clicking Tintypes sets 'Showing: Tintypes') in addition to marking the button active; the post-click terminal state reflects the selected filter, not the default 'Showing: All plates'.
The desktop (1440px) and tablet (834px) layouts stay within their viewports.

The Masonry grid, the plate thumbnails, the click-to-open full-plate preview with its close control, and the six-room Umbra Salt header navigation remain reachable and unchanged, and the static site keeps a clean browser console (no remote CDN/font errors).
design_constraints: Add the SAME shared 'Archive ledger' rail to The Salt Shelf, The Plate Ledger and the Tidewrack Room so the holdings vocabulary is consistent across the archive rooms; do not add it to only one page.
Fix the responsive layout of the ledger metric row; do not delete the ledger, change its four metrics, or restyle unrelated sections.

Preserve the salt-print design language: dark #252323 ground, restrained green accents, the Masonry plate grid and the original click-to-open preview; the ledger must render in the dark on-palette language, not a bright pale slab.
Keep the plate filter interaction wired end to end (the #ledger-readout terminal readout must reflect the clicked filter), not merely a class toggle.
Do not introduce external stylesheets, remote fonts, CDNs, or new remote script/asset dependencies; the site must stay a self-contained static site with a clean console.
state_constraints: desktop_initial, tablet_initial and mobile_initial protect the loaded masonry grid, masthead, current-collection navigation, thumbnails, related links and responsive layout after the restyle.
desktop_demo2 and desktop_demo5 protect the alternate collection routes and their rewritten caption panels (archival plate notes rather than vegan quotes / surreal filler).
desktop_grid_scrolled protects the lower grid and related content so the restyle applies through the whole page, not just above the fold.
desktop_preview_assemblage, desktop_preview_zephyr and mobile_preview_assemblage capture the opened preview showing the plate title in the caption panel with the close control present.
desktop_preview_closed captures the preview after the close action, returning to the grid without breaking GridFx.
Source inspection confirms the page is static HTML/CSS/JS driven by GridFx + masonry with local imagery, so the restyle is caption/preview/masthead content rather than a rebuild.

change_completion: The shared 'Archive ledger' rail appears on The Salt Shelf, The Plate Ledger and the Tidewrack Room.
The ledger metric row renders within the viewport on mobile.
The plate-filter click updates the #ledger-readout terminal readout to the selected filter.
design_consistency: The dark salt-print palette, header navigation, Masonry plate rhythm and preview are preserved.
The 'Archive ledger' keeps the dark on-palette look and is visually faithful to the reference across the three pages.
interaction_continuity: Clicking a filter button updates the 'Showing:' readout to the selected filter (post-click terminal state reflects the change, not the default).
regression: The Masonry grid, the plate thumbnails, the click-to-open preview and close control remain reachable and unchanged.
The static site serves from index.html with a clean browser console.
responsive: 390px home page (initial, ledger) and 834px tablet have no horizontal overflow beyond 24px.
The ledger metric tiles wrap or shrink cleanly instead of forcing a fixed-width row.

author_notes: Repo-grounded static-gallery Edit/state_continuity task hardened to L4. The reference (a) promotes a shared 'Archive ledger' rail onto The Salt Shelf, The Plate Ledger and the Tidewrack Room pages in the dark salt-print palette, (b) repairs the ledger metric-row mobile overflow (fixed 900px nowrap -> wrapping flex 1 1 200px), and (c) wires the plate filter so the #ledger-readout terminal readout reflects the clicked filter. The bad 'smart-wrong' solution narrows the row to 620px + overflow-x:hidden (still overflows -> D6 fail), adds the ledger to the home page only (D2 cross-page fail on The Plate Ledger + Tidewrack Room), restyles the ledger into a bright pale slab (D3 visual_regression fail), and toggles the filter button's .is-active class without re-syncing #ledger-readout (click succeeds but the terminal readout stays 'Showing: All plates' -> D4 interaction_assertions fail). It fails FOUR distinct gates while all text/completion/regression/console signals pass.

metadata.selected_repo_reason: codrops ImageGridEffects pure-static masonry photography grid with a JS open/close preview; state_continuity restyle into the Umbra Salt salt-print/tintype archive across masthead, collection navigation, grid captions, caption panels, opened preview and footer while preserving GridFx.
